keywords: Slip On Sock Style Casual Shoes
custom: Pull-on ribbed shaft; geometric knit panels; sculpted sole
highlights:
Tall sock-style shape: A ribbed shaft rises above the ankle and gives the shoe a distinctive high-top profile.

Pull-on construction: The continuous knitted opening creates a slip-on entry without a lace fastening.

Geometric upper pattern: Contrasting knit zones form visible angled lines around the forefoot, instep and heel.

Sculpted sole profile: A layered sidewall with diagonal grooves runs around the heel. Original bottom photos show the actual segmented tread layout.

Four colour assortments: Grey, White, All Black and Black/White are listed in EU38-46 for wholesale combinations.
